title: Gradual Code-Switching as Inference-Time Cross-Lingual Representational Alignment for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2510.05678v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved notable progress in multilingual settings, their performance remains uneven across languages as LLMs often rely on English-centric latent representations. In this work, we introduce code-switching in-context learning (CSICL), an inference-time mechanism for cross-lingual representational alignment. Rather than relying on an abrupt translation pivot, CSICL explicitly scaffolds the reasoning trajectory by gradually transitioning from a target language to English, aligning non-English inputs with an English-centric reasoning space. Across 4 LLMs, 6 datasets, and 10 languages, CSICL consistently outperforms cross-lingual in-context learning baselines, yielding average gains of 6.0pp and 4.8pp in target and unseen languages, respectively. The improvements generalize across language families and are even more pronounced in low-resource settings, with gains of 14.7pp in target and 5.3pp

translated_title: 渐进式代码切换：作为大语言模型推理时的跨语言表示对齐方法
translated_abstract: 虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）在多语言环境中取得了显著进展，但其性能在不同语言间仍不均衡，因为LLMs往往依赖于以英语为中心的潜在表示。在本工作中，我们引入了代码切换上下文学习（CSICL），这是一种用于跨语言表示对齐的推理时机制。CSICL不依赖于突然的翻译切换，而是通过逐步从目标语言过渡到英语来明确构建推理轨迹，将非英语输入与以英语为中心的推理空间对齐。在4个LLMs、6个数据集和10种语言中，CSICL始终优于跨语言上下文学习基线，在目标语言和未见语言上分别平均提升6.0个百分点和4.8个百分点。这些改进跨语言家族普遍适用，在低资源设置中效果更为显著，目标语言和未见语言分别提升14.7个百分点和5.3个百分点。
tldr: 本文提出CSICL，一种推理时渐进式代码切换方法，通过逐步将目标语言过渡到英语对齐跨语言表示，显著提升LLMs在多种语言（尤其是低资源语言）上的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CSICL, an inference-time gradual code-switching method that aligns cross-lingual representations by progressively transitioning from target languages to English, significantly improving LLM performance across languages, especially in low-resource settings.
